scenario: Two friends deciding on which movie to watch on a movie night.
learner_goal: Insist on watching a thriller (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been looking forward to watching a new thriller movie that has just been released.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Persuade the friend to watch a comedy (<extra_info>Extra information: you do not like thrillers and would prefer to watch a comedy movie instead.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Finnegan O'Malley
transcript.content: Noah, there's a new thriller that just came out and I've been looking forward to it for weeks. Could we watch that tonight? I’ll make the tea and popcorn — please, it would mean a lot to me.

transcript.speaker: Noah Davis
transcript.content: Finnegan — thanks, that means a lot that you’d make tea and popcorn. I totally get why you’re excited about the thriller, but full disclosure: thrillers make me edge-of-the-seat anxious and I’m hoping for something light tonight. How about a compromise — comedy tonight, thriller next time? I can pick something I think you’ll like (maybe The Nice Guys or The Grand Budapest Hotel), or you pick a comedy and I’ll bring dessert next time — or even host a poolside screening for the thriller when we do it. Sound fair?

transcript.speaker: Finnegan O'Malley
transcript.content: I get that thrillers make you anxious, and I don't want to put you in an uncomfortable spot, Noah — but could we try the thriller tonight with a few compromises? I'll pick a milder, less jump-scare one, keep the lights on and volume down, we can sit farther back and pause anytime; if it bothers you we'll switch to a comedy straight away. It would mean a lot to me, and I'll happily bring dessert or let you pick the next movie to make up for it.

transcript.speaker: Noah Davis
transcript.content: Finnegan — I really appreciate you offering to make it cozy and to dial things down. That means a lot. Truth is thrillers still spike my anxiety and I’d spend the whole movie tense and not really present, which would be a bummer for both of us. Could we do a comedy tonight so I can actually relax and enjoy the evening with you? You can pick any comedy you want (Hot Fuzz, The Nice Guys, or something you love) and I’ll bring dessert next time — and I promise we’ll do the thriller soon: poolside screening if you’re up for it, and I’ll host so we can set the lights/volume exactly how you like. How’s that sound?

transcript.speaker: Finnegan O'Malley
transcript.content: Alright, Noah — comedy tonight it is. Could we lock in a night for the thriller next Friday? I’ve been looking forward to it and having a set plan would mean a lot; I’ll bring dessert and we can do your poolside screening if that still works. Thanks for being flexible.

transcript.speaker: Noah Davis
transcript.content: Perfect — thanks, Finnegan. Let’s lock the thriller for next Friday at my place; poolside screening sounds great. What time works for you? For tonight, comedy it is: Fancy The Nice Guys or The Grand Budapest Hotel, or pick any comedy you’d prefer? You doing tea and popcorn tonight is perfect — I’ll bring dessert next time. Really looking forward to hanging out.
